description: Election Commission - Declare that H. M. Somawathi as a member of the Badalkumbura PS
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Badalkumbura Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the declaration of a new member due to a vacancy caused by non-attendance of meetings, which falls squarely under Election-related matters (Type 7) rather than general government personnel changes.
